- You rely on concrete observability tools and DORA metrics to diagnose bottlenecks, resolve production incidents, and continuously improve platform reliability and delivery speeds.

- You enjoy working closely with cross-functional AI/ML and data teams to bridge the gap between development and operations, while actively mentoring peers.

- You work exceptionally well independently, taking complete ownership of complex infrastructure initiatives and communicating technical concepts with Staff-level clarity.

## What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain.

- Strong hands-on experience using Terraform (modules, workspaces, remote state) for Infrastructure as Code and designing/maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines with runners and automated deployments.

- Proven expertise in centralized monitoring using Prometheus and Grafana (custom exporters, dashboards, alerting) alongside tuning alerting systems (Alertmanager, PagerDuty, OpsGenie).

- Solid, hands-on understanding of DevOps/DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, MTTR) to measure and drive engineering improvements.

Domain: Product Security / AppSec / DevSecOps / AI Security / AI-First SDLC

## Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Staff Product Security Engineer to join and lead initiatives across our product security landscape. In this role, you will redefine modern Product Security by architecting an AI-first SDLC seamlessly integrating traditional AppSec with advanced AI security practices, automating shift-left pipelines, conducting rigorous threat models for core services and complex AI architectures, and leveraging cutting-edge AI tools to accelerate vulnerability remediation. You will partner directly with engineering leadership, Information Security, GRC, BuildOps, and DevOps teams to secure our SaaS products and safely enable cutting-edge agentic features.

## Role & Responsibilities

- AI-First SDLC & Shift-Left Automation: Architect and embed AI-driven security controls (SAST, DAST, SCA, Container, Secrets Detection) directly into CI/CD build pipelines and developer workflows, establishing an intelligent, highly automated AI-first SDLC.

- Operational & Strategic AI Security: Leverage AI tooling operationally (e.g., auto-triage, threat-model drafting, fix generation) while strategizing security controls for product-facing AI features.

- AI & Emerging Tech Threat Modeling: Assess risks specific to Generative and Agentic AI architectures, including MCP integrations, autonomous agents, tool-calling interfaces, multi-agent communication, prompt injections, and memory/context poisoning (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs / Agentic Apps).

- Developer Guidance & Vulnerability Remediation: Review code (Python, Go, Javascript, etc), triage findings, and partner with engineering to implement robust short and long-term security fixes.

- Supply Chain & Software Integrity: Manage third-party open-source risks, open-source dependency tracking, Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), and secure MCP/agent server ecosystems.

- Enablement & Champions Program: Conduct secure coding workshops, train developers on secure AI usage, and help grow an active Security Champions network.

## Skills & Qualifications

- Experience: 6–10 years of product security engineering experience in a SaaS environment, with a proven track record of technical leadership.

- AppSec Fundamentals: Deep expertise in OWASP Top 10, CWE 25, threat modeling, cryptography, container security, and secure SDLC frameworks (SAMM, Microsoft SDL).

- AI Security & AI-First SDLC Expertise: Strong hands-on expertise with AI-first SDLC methodologies and reviewing AI security risks specifically around Agentic AI systems, MCP security (authorization, tool poisoning, confused deputy risks), and LLM security controls.

- Operational AI Use-Cases: Experience using AI tools to optimize security engineering workflows (e.g., automating root-cause analysis, threat modeling assistance, automated policy generation).

- Programming & Tooling: Proficient in code review and scripting with Python, Go, or Javascript (hands-on development experience is a major plus). Hands-on with tools like Burp Suite, Snyk, OWASP ZAP, and CI/CD security scanners.

- Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in CS/IT or equivalent. Relevant certifications (OSCP, OSWE, CSSLP, GIAC) or active community contributions (OWASP, BSides, NullCon, Black Hat, etc) are a plus.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
About Druva:

You won't just join a company at Druva; you'll help shape the future of data security at the moment it matters most. We are building a modern standard with our cloud-native solutions, designed to simplify the toughest challenges in cyber resilience for our customers. As the pioneer and market leader in fully managed SaaS data protection, we help organizations secure and recover their data from ransomware, cyberattacks, and operational disruptions without the complexity, cost, or risk of legacy infrastructure.

Our momentum is backed by the market: Druva was named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Backup and Data Protection Platforms, a Leader in the IDC MarketScape for Cyber-Recovery, and a Leader & Outperformer in the GigaOm Cloud Data Protection Radar. Even better, customers validate that leadership every day through standout Net Promoter Scores (NPS) and Gartner Peer Insights ratings. Today, the platform protects over 450PB of customer data across 26 global regions and runs more than 7 billion backups a year.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X, and Facebook.

## Team & Mission: Druva Product Platform

The Druva Product Platform team builds the shared core SaaS foundation that every Druva product line runs on. We build and operate the multi-tenant control plane, distributed APIs, tenant lifecycle and provisioning pipelines, Identity & Access Management (IAM/RBAC), distributed job orchestration, usage metering, and platform observability.

When a new workload or product capability ships at Druva, it ships on top of what this team owns. That makes the work high-leverage and high-blast-radius: our services are multi-tenant, globally distributed, always-on, and measured against strict availability and latency objectives at a scale of thousands of enterprise customers and billions of operations per year.

## Role Overview

As a Senior Software Engineer (Development) on the Druva Product Platform team, you will be a core backend engineer responsible for designing, developing, scaling, and operating critical multi-tenant microservices and APIs. You will own complex technical deliverables end-to-end—from architectural documents and high-performance Go/Python implementations to automated CI/CD deployments and production telemetry.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for an engineer who thrives on distributed systems challenges, concurrency, high data throughput, and building foundational platform services that empower other engineers.

## Key Skills:

- 5–8+ years of hands-on experience in software product development, building high-scale distributed systems and SaaS backends.

- Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) and/or Python , with deep understanding of concurrency (goroutines/async I/O), memory management, and data structures.

- Solid experience in designing, building, and maintaining microservices and REST/gRPC APIs in high-throughput multi-tenant environments.

- Deep hands-on experience with AWS Cloud services (such as EKS, EC2, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, SNS, Lambda) and containerization ( Docker, Kubernetes ).

- Strong database expertise across relational engines (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and distributed NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch).

- Proven experience with event-driven architectures and message streaming systems (Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/EventBridge).

- Demonstrated ownership of services in production: telemetry/instrumentation (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), SLI/SLO monitoring, on-call support, and root cause analysis (RCA).

- Solid commitment to lean engineering practices: automated unit/integration testing, CI/CD pipelines, and rigorous peer code reviews.

## Desirable Skills:

- Demonstrated experience building multi-tenant platform primitives: tenant isolation, rate limiting/token buckets, quota management, and schema migrations.

- Domain expertise in data protection, backup/recovery, storage systems, virtualization, or cyber resilience (RPO/RTO).

- Knowledge of enterprise authentication and authorization standards (OAuth 2.0, SAML, OIDC, RBAC/ABAC, mTLS).

- Exposure to AI/LLM integration patterns (vector search, prompt engineering pipelines, LLM agent integration).

- Experience in high-growth, fast-paced SaaS product environments.

## Role and Responsibilities:

- Architect, implement, and maintain high-performance, resilient microservices in Go/Python that serve as the backbone for Druva's SaaS platform.

- Design clean, backward-compatible, secure RESTful and gRPC APIs consumed by internal product engineering teams and enterprise customers.

- Author clear technical design documents evaluating architectural trade-offs across latency, consistency, scalability, and cost.

- Optimize database queries, caching strategies, and data models across PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and Redis for sub-millisecond responsiveness.

- Drive production operational excellence: set up granular telemetry (metrics, traces, logs), define SLOs, and participate in on-call incident response.

title: Software Engineer - IAM
description:
Location : Pune
About Team & About Role:

As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org.

You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains.

We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems.

- Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions.

- Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought.

- Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic.

- Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.

- Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed.

- Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET.

- Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.).

- Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature.

- Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.

Requirements

Must-have

- Strong hands-on programming skills in Golang .

- Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.

- Working knowledge of Active Directory .

- Applied cryptography/PKI experience: X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS .

- Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.

- Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.

- Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.

- Simple, effective written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-have

- Directory internals (schema, bind operations).

- HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).

- Build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI).

- Secret-manager internals, Redis, Win32, policy engines.

- Basic C#/.NET (to maintain the companion app).

Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.
Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.
Culture and Total Rewards
Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.
Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.
We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.
To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.
At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, we uphold the following principles:
Equal Opportunity: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
Accessible Workplace: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
Inclusive Hiring Process: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
Career Growth: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
Support & Confidentiality: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
Awareness & Inclusion: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.
Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.

title: Manager – GTM & Sales Strategy, Meesho AI Services (MAS)
description:
About the Team
MAS's mission is to accelerate the build and deployment of an AI workforce for every business — from kirana to conglomerate. Our vision is to deliver a billion-plus workflows through our agents in ways that drive real client outcomes, not automation for its own sake.
We go deep rather than wide. Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. We're deliberately building a technology company, not an AI BPO: models are a commodity, so our moat is the workflow knowledge, integrations, and client relationships that only come from actually running the work — not a generic AI layer bolted onto a call centre.
We've proven this model works — with marquee clients across consumer durables, auto, and D2C/marketplace businesses — and we're still early. We'll keep evolving it as we go, staying client-first rather than assuming we already have the answer. This is a 0–1 business inside Meesho: no fixed playbook, high ownership, and the ground floor of how India's enterprises adopt AI-led operations.
About the Role
This role is for a GTM generalist who thrives in ambiguity, is genuinely excited about AI-led offerings, and wants to build the full range of enterprise sales skills — with an eye on growing into a closer and sales leader over time, or moving into Business/GTM Operations. Both are real paths from this seat.
You own the middle mile of the deal: the stretch between a qualified conversation and a close-ready opportunity. That means deep client discovery, mapping who really decides, understanding how a client's teams actually work today, and making sure the deal never goes cold on your watch — following up, keeping momentum, and setting up the closer to walk into the room fully briefed. Our central team owns top-of-funnel lead-gen, but this isn't a purely inbound or coordination role — you'll still make cold calls and run early client meetings yourself when a deal needs it.
A lot of enterprise AI-services deals across this market stall before signature for a simple reason: nobody on the deal ever gets deep enough into the account to know what the client is actually buying, or who really decides. That's exactly the gap this role exists to close — the middle mile is where deals live or die.

## What You Will Do
- Own the middle mile of the sales cycle — from a client's first "yes, let's talk" through to a well-packaged, close-ready opportunity.

- Run structured discovery conversations to understand a client's real pain points, current workflows, and AI-readiness.

- Map client org structures — identify the true economic buyer, decision-makers, influencers, and blockers — and keep stakeholder engagement alive between senior-level touchpoints.

- Help identify and nurture an internal champion for MAS within the account — someone advocating for us when we're not in the room.

- Support structured, MEDDPICC-style account qualification alongside your closer, so every deal has an honest diagnosis of what's actually blocking it.

- Make cold calls and run client meetings yourself where needed, working alongside (not just waiting on) the central lead-gen team.

- Own the follow-up cadence after every client conversation — chasing next steps, addressing objections, and making sure momentum doesn't drop.

- Build a working understanding of MAS's guaranteed-savings and outcome-based pricing models (per-minute, slab-based, pilot, risk-sharing) and contribute early pricing inputs on deals you're driving.

- Brief and prep senior closers ahead of high-stakes conversations — sharp account context, clear stakeholder maps, clear next steps.

- Bonus: build and iterate on client-specific product demos in partnership with Product/Tech.

- Feed client and market insights back into the sales playbook and to Product, Tech, and Ops.

- Bring structured, consultative thinking to every account rather than a transactional, task-based approach.

## What you will need
- 4–7 years of experience in enterprise sales, GTM, business consulting, or client-facing analyst/BD roles, ideally with exposure to Indian mid-market/enterprise clients.

- Strong discovery and analytical skills — able to quickly and accurately unpack a client's business problem and current workflow.

- Comfort making cold calls and running early client meetings — this is not a purely inbound or coordination role.

- A structured communicator — able to produce crisp meeting notes, account maps, and follow-up briefs.

- Basic commercial acumen — able to understand and reason about pricing structures (you won't be expected to own pricing negotiations independently yet).

- Genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technology — you don't need to code, but you should "get it."

- Exposure to (or curiosity about) structured account-qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC is a plus — we'll teach you the specifics.

- High ownership and follow-through — comfortable chasing a deal over weeks or months without losing momentum.

- Comfortable working in ambiguity, without established playbooks, in a 0–1/1–10 business environment.

- Ambition to grow — either toward a full closing/sales-leadership role, or into Business/GTM Operations — over time.

- Bonus: prior exposure to building or presenting product demos.

- Evidence that you're genuinely top-tier talent — that might show up as academic pedigree (a strong record at a top institute) or as a professional track record (success at a recognizable brand, or a reputation for excellence in high-stakes client work). We care about the evidence of excellence, not which box it comes from.
